mechanism_narrative: A continued recovery in WORKPLACES mobility and TRANSIT use raises weekday shopping trips and lunch-time errands, so RETAIL_REC should be higher over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 4-week mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated while TRANSIT remains depressed, more trips are likely being localized to neighborhood retail, making RETAIL_REC rise within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays more than 30 points below baseline while RESIDENTIAL stays above +15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -30 and RESIDENTIAL remaining above +15.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM without a matching rise in PARKS indicates essential local activity is normalizing, which spills over into nearby retail visits and lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above +8 after being below +5
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days after GROCERY_PHARM crosses above +8 while PARKS remains below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both soften, discretionary outdoor and home-centered activity is giving way to commercial outings, so retail and recreation mobility should improve over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by at least 5 points week-on-week and RESIDENTIAL falls by at least 1 point week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next 7 days after both PARKS and RESIDENTIAL decline together.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in TRANSIT combined with WORKPLACES signals commuting normalization, which should keep generating incremental retail stops and push RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over 28 days despite simultaneous multiweek increases in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL continues to ease while GROCERY_PHARM stays positive, household routines are spreading outward again, which should shift spending back into retail and recreation venues within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below +18 while GROCERY_PHARM remains above +5
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 2-week mean within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below +18 and GROCERY_PHARM stays above +5.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, a further drop in TRANSIT should precede lower discretionary retail movement, so RETAIL_REC will fall over the next four weeks if transit weakness deepens.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -35 after already being below -30 for two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT falling below -35 and staying there.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both stall or reverse while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, commuters are staying home more and retail trips should weaken after one week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT each decline week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL stays above +15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both fall while RESIDENTIAL remains above +15.
